claims.text: ApiClient.login posts {email, password} as JSON with a Content-Type header to $baseUrl/auth/login, throws Exception('login failed (<status>)') for any status other than 200, and on 200 reads the token field and stores it in _token before returning it.
ApiClient._headers adds 'Authorization': 'Bearer $_token' when _token is not null; createOrder sends _headers, fetchProducts sends no token.

_submit sets _loading and clears _error; on success it checks mounted and replaces the screen with CreateOrderScreen; on an exception it sets _error to e.toString(); finally resets _loading. build shows _error in red and disables the button with a spinner while _loading.
Dart's Exception('login failed (401)').toString() is "Exception: login failed (401)".

claims.text: The ApiClient is created when the app starts (in DonHangApp.build) and the token is kept only in its _token field, so reloading the web page starts the app again with no token.

In the Try-it, the Network tab lists a login entry per attempt (POST 401 from step 1, the browser's preliminary OPTIONS, POST 200); the last POST 200 response is a JSON object with one token field. The sign-in icon is at the top right of the product screen's app bar.
